text:
Type: white deep box picture frame
Use: displaying photos or art prints on a wall, a shelf or a desk; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: white painted frame with a deep square profile, off-white mat, clear front panel, folding back stand
Colors: white, off-white mat
Shape: rectangular portrait frame with a wide flat front, deep boxy edges, a broad mat around the picture, stands upright or hangs, compact and clean
Feel: clean, light, tidy, simple
Goes with: gallery walls, picture ledges, light wood, black and white prints; Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

product.name: RIBBA
product.description: Can be used hanging or standing, both horizontally and vertically, to fit in the space available.
